title.narrative: Solutions for the Internally Displaced and Host Communities Project

description.narrative: The objective of the Project is to improve access to basic services and economic opportunities for internally displaced persons (IDPs) and host communities in target local government areas (LGAs) in northern Nigeria

The project aims to provide targeted development solutions to support building a better future for both IDPs and host communities in Northern Nigeria. To move from emergency crisis response to longer-term development solutions for displacement-affected states and communities, the project will provide both technical and financial support to: 1) improve access to climate resilient infrastructure and services; and 2) provide improved livelihood opportunities for IDPs and members of host communities, and community integration through financing cooperatives and market sustainability, and social cohesion and peace building activities.
